correctness.rationale: Exact rectangular block singular values follow from disjoint palindrome completion supports. The empty-word column diverges precisely at q r^4≥1. Counting palindromes and all word splits gives the exact HS norm. Length-gauge diagonal pinching proves the strong Schatten necessity q r^(2p)<1; summing complete block Schatten norms proves sufficiency for all p≥1. At 1<p<2 critical r, bandwise explicit singular-value multiplicities and a summable equivalent weak Schatten Ky Fan norm yield endpoint membership, while pinching rules out strong membership. Finite checker runs q=2 and q=3 confirm only the finite block calculations; analytic arguments prove infinite assertions.

value.rationale: This solves a naturally motivated regularization problem for the canonical nonregular palindrome language using an operator structure introduced in the recent 2026 language-Hankel paper. It determines the entire all-p Schatten phase, an exact Hilbert--Schmidt invariant, exact length-block singular values and a genuinely nontrivial weak-but-not-strong critical regime, showing that weighted Hilbert compactness and trace ideal regularity differ. It is not a tiny finite table or arbitrary parameter slice; it avoids unsupported claims about all languages.
